name: KORE
description: KORE is the structured substrate that makes Claude a research partner for laboratory scientists. The platform extracts metadata and intellectual work product from instruments, manuscripts, grants, and protocols once at the source, then makes that knowledge available to Claude through compact reasoning-ready context. Two read-only tools; search_kore and get_record. Let Claude query a scientist's extracted KORE corpus and retrieve focal records with neighboring context for compositional reasoning. Designed for genomics labs and university core facilities. KORE captures instrument and intellectual work product only; never patient data, IRB-regulated content, or raw sequence files.

_published_faq.name: How do I add KORE to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add KORE to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.gravl.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the KORE MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: KORE provides these MCP tools: search_kore and get_record.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to KORE?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to KORE in healthcare on the Manufact MCP catalog include Virtual Fly Brain, Aniva, ClinicalTrials.gov Explorer (by BLEN), Health Data Avatar (HDA), and PubCrawl.
KORE requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
KORE is developed by GRAVL, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
